title: LogEvent
description: Luoc do trung gian chung cho moi nguon log: message tren topic parsed-logs (dau ra job 1) va bang logs.log_events trong ClickHouse. Dinh nghia goc nam o lib_log_handler/schema.py.

event_time.description: Thoi diem ghi trong log goc, ISO 8601 UTC

ingest_time.description: Thoi diem Log Producer gui vao Kafka

host.description: Ten may sinh log (ten chuan sau khi gop bi danh); Windows: ten co dinh WIN-CBS-01 vi nguon khong ghi

level.description: Muc log nguyen ban cua nguon (chi Windows co); null voi Linux va Mac

severity.description: Muc do theo thang chung = muc cao hon giua muc log cua nguon va muc suy tu noi dung

pid.description: Ma tien trinh; null neu nguon khong ghi (Windows, dong kernel cua Linux)

content.description: Noi dung thong diep, dau vao cua Drain

label.description: 'inject' neu la dong chen thu (chi de danh gia); null voi dong goc

template_id.description: Dinh danh mau: K... (known) hoac U... (unknown)

template.description: Mau log voi <*> thay cho tham so

quality_flags.description: Cac co chat luong, cach nhau dau phay (vd missing_host)

action.description: Ket qua normalizer; dong 'reject' di sang topic rejected-logs

injected.description: true neu la dong mau la do Log Producer chen vao

seq.description: So thu tu dong trong lan phat

x-raw-message.description: Message tren topic raw-logs.* (dau ra Log Producer)
